findings.claim: Resolver-only target authorization is still coupled to the case-write target path instead of an independent administering-entity target check.
findings.evidence: The retained repair claim says resolver-only callers were fixed by adding `AppServices::authorize_administering_entity_target`, but that method checks `resolve_administering_entity` and then calls `self.cases.authorize_case_write_target(context, case_id)`, while the PostgreSQL implementation in `crates/aso-web-server/src/adapters/gate.rs` executes `SELECT aso.authorize_case_write_target($1)`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a resolver-specific repository target method/SQL function that verifies case scope without requiring or invoking the case-write target, and use it from `authorize_administering_entity_target`.
